title: Ostomy Supply Program Financial-Hardship Waivers
content:
The Ostomy Supply Program posts a financial-hardship waiver against one patient-balance posting when Larkfield's financial counseling team has approved the customer's hardship application.

## When a waiver is owed

A hardship waiver is owed once Larkfield's financial counseling team has approved a hardship application on a tier where hardship waivers are allowed and the posting the application names carries no hardship waiver yet. It is posted once, against that named posting, for the most recently received approved application. A program whose most recent approved application's posting already carries a hardship waiver, or that has no approved application, owes no waiver under this policy.

| The program's records (general cases) | Waiver under this policy |
|---|---|
| Most recently received approved hardship application names a posting that carries no hardship waiver | Owed - one waiver against that named posting |
| The posting named on the most recently received approved application already carries a hardship waiver | None |
| No approved hardship application | None |

## Effect once posted

The waiver is recorded as a balance adjustment of the hardship-waiver reason linked to the posting it adjusts, and the enrollment's balance due falls by the amount waived; the waiver then shows on the enrollment's billing history with the day's posting date.

## Posting the waiver: `post_hardship_waiver_31941945`

`post_hardship_waiver_31941945` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`). It posts a financial-hardship waiver on an Ostomy Supply Program enrollment against one patient-balance posting.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ostomy_program_id` | The reference number of the Ostomy Supply Program enrollment the waiver is posted on, read from the enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `original_ostomy_ledger_id` | The reference number of the billing record (the patient-balance posting) the waiver adjusts, read from the billing history or the customer request lookup of that enrollment | Identifier |
| `amount` | The amount waived in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent by the caller; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` ("posted" when the waiver was recorded), `ostomy_ledger_id` (the reference number of the new adjustment record), `ostomy_program_id` (the enrollment adjusted), `original_ostomy_ledger_id` (the posting adjusted), `adjustment_reason` (always `hardship_waiver`), `amount` (the USD amount waived, 2 decimal places), `posting_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `patient_balance_due` (the enrollment's balance due in USD after the waiver, 2 decimal places). No other return is defined.
